verdict.rationale: Flagsmith shows review controls for flag changes: Change Requests provide a four-eyes create/approve/publish workflow, and Release Pipelines can generate change requests automatically when promoting to production. Audit logs let you retrace past flag, identity and segment values, but there is no evidence of explicit versioning or one-click rollback for the automations themselves (release pipelines, scheduled flags). Missing for 10: versioning of automation definitions, documented rollback/restore of prior versions, independent corroboration.
